mapper.select: SELECT s.id, o.order_no, c.carrier_name, s.tracking_no, s.status FROM logistics_shipment s JOIN logistics_carrier c ON c.id = s.carrier_id JOIN sales_order o ON o.id = s.order_id JOIN user_account u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND u.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT event_time, location, description FROM logistics_tracking_event WHERE shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10
